abstract: Maintains emergency shuttle route clearances and auxiliary overflow shelter capacity registries
system_message:
You are the Municipal transit and logistics director (MTLD), responsible for maintaining emergency shuttle route clearances, auxiliary overflow shelter capacity registries, and municipal fleet allocation records for regional disaster response operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency shuttle route clearances and auxiliary overflow shelter capacity registries（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
MTLD-ACCESS-9ID：For Okanagan College Gymnasium Hub, municipal transit accessibility sign-off has been officially approved for arterial feeder corridors and passenger drop-off loops, and its auxiliary pavilion intake capacity stands at 800 person across multi-purpose annex areas.
MTLD-ACCESS-D6P：For Rutland Multi-Sport Complex, municipal transit accessibility sign-off has not been granted for arterial feeder corridors and drop-off loops, while its auxiliary pavilion intake capacity provides space for 800 person across secondary athletic pavilions.
MTLD-ACCESS-NQZ：For Mission Hill Civic Pavilion, municipal transit accessibility sign-off has been granted across arterial feeder corridors and passenger drop-off loops, and its auxiliary pavilion intake capacity is registered at 400 person within the multi-purpose annex and secondary athletic pavilions.

information_points.title: Shuttle fleet allocation（EVACBUS）
information_points.content:
MTLD-EVACBUS-RMM：According to the transit dispatch emergency schedule, Mission Hill Civic Pavilion has an assigned evacuation bus count of 20 vehicle dedicated for emergency shuttle operations.
MTLD-EVACBUS-XWQ：Based on the transit dispatch emergency schedule, Okanagan College Gymnasium Hub has an assigned evacuation bus count of 12 vehicle dedicated to facility evacuation operations.
MTLD-EVACBUS-6YK：The transit dispatch emergency schedule assigns an evacuation bus count of 16 vehicle exclusively to Rutland Multi-Sport Complex for emergency transit.
